```{r}
color <- c( "#9eaad1","#f59790", "#dacfe5", "#f5dbb6", "#cde2e8", "#C8D4E9","#b8e0c8", "#f2c4ce", "#e8e0b5"  )
```

```{r}

# 比较K vs S  
KSmarkers <- FindMarkers(  
  object = sk_endo,  
  ident.1 = "K",  # 实验组/处理组 
  ident.2 = "S",  # 对照组
  group.by = "group"  # 假设分组信息存储在"group"列
)  

# 保存原始差异分析结果  
write.csv(KSmarkers, "output/markers_full_KS.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# 假设您的差异分析结果已经保存在 KSmarkers 中
# 1. 整理数据，添加显著性分组
plot_data <- KSmarkers %>%
  # 将行名（基因名）提取为新的一列
  mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
  mutate(
    # 计算 -log10(p_val_adj)，加上极小值防止 p=0 时计算报错
    logP = -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300), 
    
    # 设定上下调的分组依据 (P<0.05 且 log2FC绝对值>1)
    Significance = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1 ~ "Up-regulated",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

table(plot_data$Significance)

# 2. 指定你想标记的基因
genes_to_label <- c("DUSP1")

# 3. 开始画图
volcano_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = logP, color = Significance)) +
  # 画所有的点
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
  # 自定义点颜色 (红色上调，蓝色下调，灰色不显著)
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "#f59790", 
                                "Down-regulated" = "#9eaad1", 
                                "Not Significant" = "#CCCCCC")) +
                                
  # 阈值辅助线 (虚线)
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  
  # 核心：使用 ggrepel 标记指定基因
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(plot_data, gene %in% genes_to_label),
    aes(label = gene),
    color = "black",            # 标签文本颜色
    size = 5,                   # 字体大小
    fontface = "italic",        # 基因名斜体
    box.padding = 0.8,          # 标签外围空白，防止重叠
    point.padding = 0.5,        # 标签离点的距离
    segment.color = "black",    # 连接线的颜色
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.015, "npc")) # 连接线带个小箭头
  ) +
  # 图像美化主题
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot of K vs S",
    x = "Average Log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-Log10(Adjusted P-value)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

# 显示图像
print(volcano_plot)

# 保存图像为 PDF 或 PNG
ggsave("output/Volcano_K_vs_S_DUSP1.pdf", plot = volcano_plot, width = 7, height = 6)
ggsave("output/Volcano_K_vs_S_DUSP1.png", plot = volcano_plot, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# 1. 提取DUSP1在K和S两组中的表达量
DefaultAssay(sk_endo) <- "RNA"
dusp1_expr <- FetchData(
  object = sk_endo,
  vars = "DUSP1",
  layer = "data"
)

# 2. 添加分组信息
dusp1_data <- dusp1_expr %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
  mutate(group = sk_endo$group) %>%
  filter(group %in% c("K", "S"))

# 3. 计算每组的平均表达量、标准差、标准误
dusp1_summary <- dusp1_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(DUSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_expr = sd(DUSP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_expr = sd_expr / sqrt(n()),
    n = n()
  )

# 4. 计算组间P值
# 方式一：直接用Wilcoxon秩和检验（与Seurat FindMarkers默认方法一致）
wilcox_res <- wilcox.test(DUSP1 ~ group, data = dusp1_data)
p_value <- wilcox_res$p.value

# 方式二（备选）：如果想直接用KSmarkers里已经算好的p_val_adj
# p_value <- KSmarkers["DUSP1", "p_val_adj"]

# 格式化p值显示（科学计数法或星号）
p_label <- case_when(
  p_value < 0.0001 ~ "****",
  p_value < 0.001  ~ "***",
  p_value < 0.01   ~ "**",
  p_value < 0.05   ~ "*",
  TRUE             ~ "ns"
)

p_text <- paste0("P = ", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2), 
                  "  (", p_label, ")")

# 5. 确定标注的y轴高度（略高于误差条最高点）
y_max <- max(dusp1_summary$mean_expr + dusp1_summary$se_expr) * 1.15
y_bracket <- y_max * 1.05

# 6. 绘制柱形图并添加P值标注
dusp1_barplot <- ggplot(dusp1_summary, aes(x = group, y = mean_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_expr - se_expr, ymax = mean_expr + se_expr),
    width = 0.2,
    size = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("K" = "#3498db", "S" = "#e74c3c")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Expression of DUSP1 in K vs S",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Average Expression Level",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # 添加显著性括号
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket),
               color = "black", size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket * 0.97),
               color = "black", size = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket * 0.97),
               color = "black", size = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_bracket * 1.05, 
           label = p_text, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold") +
  # 扩展y轴上限，避免标注被截断
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2)))

# 7. 显示图像
print(dusp1_barplot)

# 8. 保存图像
ggsave("output/DUSP1_expression_K_vs_S.pdf", plot = dusp1_barplot, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave("output/DUSP1_expression_K_vs_S.png", plot = dusp1_barplot, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# 9. 打印数值摘要
print(dusp1_summary)
cat("Wilcoxon test p-value:", p_value, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 1J: DUSP1 与内皮 marker 共表达分析
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ---------- 1. 提取共表达数据 ----------
endo_markers <- c("PECAM1", "VWF", "KDR")

expr_data <- FetchData(
  object = sk_endo,
  vars   = c("DUSP1", endo_markers, "group")
)

# ---------- 2. DUSP1 vs PECAM1 散点图（含相关性） ----------
make_scatter <- function(data, marker, point_col = "#5a7fc1") {
  cor_val <- cor(data[["DUSP1"]], data[[marker]],
                 method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[marker]], y = DUSP1)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, color = point_col) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "#c0392b", fill = "#f5c6c6", linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = Inf,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
             label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_val, 3)),
             size = 4, fontface = "italic", color = "gray20") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("DUSP1 vs ", marker),
      x     = paste0(marker, " Expression"),
      y     = "DUSP1 Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12))
}

p_pecam1 <- make_scatter(expr_data, "PECAM1", "#5a7fc1")
p_vwf    <- make_scatter(expr_data, "VWF",    "#7fbf7f")
p_kdr    <- make_scatter(expr_data, "KDR",    "#bf9f5f")


# ---------- 3. Dot Plot：DUSP1 & 内皮 marker 在 S/K 分组中的表达 ----------
# 将 group 设为 Idents 以使用 DotPlot
sk_endo_copy <- sk_endo
Idents(sk_endo_copy) <- sk_endo_copy$group

dot_genes <- c("DUSP1", "PECAM1", "VWF", "KDR")

p_dot <- DotPlot(
  object   = sk_endo_copy,
  features = dot_genes,
  cols     = c("lightgrey", "#c0392b"),
  dot.scale = 8
) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "DUSP1 & Endothelial Markers\n(S vs K)",
    x     = "Gene",
    y     = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic")
  )


# ---------- 4. 拼图组合为 Figure 1J ----------
fig1J <- (p_pecam1 | p_vwf | p_kdr) / p_dot +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Figure 1J",
    caption = "图1J. DUSP1 与内皮细胞标志物的共表达分析。通过 DUSP1 与 PECAM1/CD31、VWF 或 KDR 等内皮\n标志基因的表达关系，进一步提示 DUSP1 在内皮细胞中具有表达，并在瘢痕疙瘩内皮细胞中降低。",
    theme   = theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "gray30")
    )
  )

print(fig1J)

ggsave("output/Fig1J_DUSP1_Coexpression.pdf", plot = fig1J, width = 14, height = 10)
ggsave("output/Fig1J_DUSP1_Coexpression.png", plot = fig1J, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 富集分析 + Figure 1K 出图（完整版）
# ============================================================

# =========================================================================
# 1. 富集分析
# =========================================================================

# 筛选显著差异基因并转换 ID
sig_genes <- KSmarkers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  rownames()

entrez_map <- bitr(sig_genes,
                   fromType = "SYMBOL",
                   toType   = "ENTREZID",
                   OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO 富集
go_res <- enrichGO(
  gene          = entrez_map$ENTREZID,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont           = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

# KEGG 富集
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = entrez_map$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "hsa",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

# 保存结果
write.csv(go_res@result,   "output/SK_GO.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(kegg_res@result, "output/SK_KEGG.csv", row.names = FALSE)

SKgo_enrich   <- go_res@result
SKkegg_enrich <- kegg_res@result

# =========================================================================
# 2. 关键词筛选函数
# =========================================================================

keywords <- "MAPK|oxidative stress|angiogenesis|blood vessel|extracellular matrix|TGF|cell migration"

filter_focus <- function(df, n = 10) {
  result <- df %>%
    filter(p.adjust < 0.05,
           str_detect(Description, regex(keywords, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice_head(n = n)
  
  # 关键词命中不足时，用 Count 最高的条目补足
  if (nrow(result) < 3) {
    result <- df %>%
      filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
      slice_head(n = n)
  }
  result
}

# =========================================================================
# 3. 通用柱形图函数
# =========================================================================

bar_plot <- function(df, title, low_col = "#72BCD5", high_col = "#F5A8A8") {
  df %>%
    arrange(Count) %>%
    mutate(Description = factor(str_wrap(Description, 40),
                                levels = str_wrap(Description, 40))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Count, y = Description, fill = -log10(p.adjust))) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.2, color = "gray20") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col, name = "-log10\n(P.adj)") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Gene Count", y = NULL) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

# =========================================================================
# 4. Figure 1K 出图
# =========================================================================

p_GO   <- bar_plot(filter_focus(SKgo_enrich,   n = 12), "GO Enrichment (S vs K)")
p_KEGG <- bar_plot(filter_focus(SKkegg_enrich, n = 10), "KEGG Enrichment (S vs K)",
                   low_col = "#a8d8a8", high_col = "#F5A8A8")

fig1K <- p_GO + p_KEGG +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "图1K. 瘢痕疙瘩内皮细胞差异表达基因 GO/KEGG 富集分析。富集结果显示，差异基因主要涉及\n血管生成、氧化应激反应、MAPK 信号、细胞迁移、细胞外基质组织及 TGF-β 相关纤维化调控等过程。",
    theme   = theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "gray30"))
  )

print(fig1K)

# =========================================================================
# 5. 保存
# =========================================================================
ggsave("output/Fig1K_GO_KEGG_focused.pdf", fig1K, width = 14, height = 7)
ggsave("output/Fig1K_GO_KEGG_focused.png", fig1K, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
